scope: Guild slash-command identity and option validation for new, auto and autooff
verified: Registration observation is bound to application, guild, command ID and name.
Registration receipts persist and cannot be rewritten by an interaction.
An ordinary user can resolve new; auto and autooff require the current explicit admin list.
Removing an admin immediately denies autonomy resolution.
The optional auto prompt remains exact data, including text resembling roles or commands.
Malformed, duplicate, unknown and wrong-type options are rejected.
Renamed and unregistered command IDs are rejected.
Reopening the journal preserves the registration binding.
remaining: Authenticated type-2 Gateway admission and ACK integration.
Transactional new-session selection without changing audience or copying private history.
Autonomy start/stop execution with fresh live channel and principal authority checks.
Actual registration, native Discord UI and multiple-turn acceptance.
Admin-DM command equivalents and the remaining parity controls.
deployment: Not registered or enabled. Existing production workers remain unchanged. A resolved binding does not itself execute a command or grant authority.
